annotations.title: Let native speakers check how natural a text sounds

description: Native German or English speakers rate how natural a text sounds (1–5) and suggest how they would say it. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional: where the text is used, e.g. 'notice on a shop door'.

text.description: The text to check (no personal data).

name: request_native_check
